notes.title: Issue Tracker now live!
notes.content:
Hello all,

We are now excited to launch our new Issue Tracker! The Issue Tracker replaces our Bug Reporting forums and can be accessed here:

https://issues.frontierstore.net/

To report a bug, simply log in with your regular Frontier account and click 'Submit Report'. You'll then be given all the steps you need to let us know about any issues you have experienced.

On this site you can:

Submit issues
Follow the status of your reports
See which issues have been reported by others
Vote on which issues matter most to you
Search for specific reports
Help contribute towards existing issues


With the launch of our new Issue Tracker the Bug Reporting forums will now be archived and all reports will now use the Issue Tracker.

Thank you for all your support so far and for helping raise awareness of the issues that are affecting your gameplay!

notes.title: PAX East 2019 - Frontier Meet Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings everyone!

It's been a while since we last got together at PAX and we've been itching for another opportunity to hang out together! Well good news! We're back for another amazing Frontier Meet up at PAX East! This is a great chance to come enjoy some food, drinks and have a little fun with the Frontier community! It's going to be a fantastic event and we can't wait to see you there!

Here's everything you need to know about the meet up:

Date: 28 March 2019

Where: Hard Rock Cafe - Faneuil Hall (Boston USA)

When: 20:00 - 00:00 (EST)

To join in the fun all you have to do is sign up and request your tickets via our Google Form here.

When you've done that you just need to sit tight and wait for the community team to respond and confirm your reserved tickets, please note tickets are on a first come, first served basis.
The confirmed tickets will come in the form of an Eventbrite invitation and you will need to confirm the Eventbrite invitation in order to attend the event.
The tickets will give you all the details of the event.
All tickets are free but please be aware that you will need to be over 21 to be allowed into the venue.
You can reserve up to two tickets per person.
The tickets are for the Frontier Community even only, tickets are not associated with entry to PAX East.

We'll email you as soon as we can once you have filled in the form. If you need more tickets or have any questions please contact us at [email]community@frontier.co.uk[/email] with the subject line 'Frontier Community Meet PAX East 2019'. You're also welcome to post any questions you might have in the thread below. 

We look forward to seeing many of you there!

notes.title: Frontier's 24 Hour Charity Stream 2018!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
 
It's that time of the year again, where it's all about giving, sharing, and celebrating. And of course we wouldn't have it any other way then to celebrate this time with you...

Frontier's 24 Hour Charity Stream!
 
On 17 December, 2018 (midday UTC), Frontier will be starting our fourth annual Charity livestream to raise money for SpecialEffect, a wonderful charity which helps people with physical disabilities use technology and play videogames. It's a charity we are all incredibly passionate about, and last year we raised over £58,000 together with you all - we can't wait to reach more milestones this year and have 24 hours full of fun activities for you to enjoy. We will be hosting several activities in the weeks to come as well as during the 24 hour stream, which will end on 18 December, midday UTC.
 
 
Charity Auction
 
This year we've got another exciting Charity Auction lined up for you; this Auction features unique prizes that you can bid on, like two special Elite Dangerous paintjobs, signed props from our Jeff Goldblum interview earlier this year, or a unique Planet Coaster cushion set (and loads more, don't worry!). We will post separately about all the prizes you can bid on in the coming week. All of the money from the Charity Auction goes to our Just Giving page for SpecialEffect, and you will receive your amazing prize (if you are the highest bidder) after the Charity stream.
 

Charity Sweepstake
 
The Charity Sweepstake is the final hour of the livestream (so 11AM UTC on 18 December) and it's the hour during which we give out loads of amazing prizes to our wonderful community. For every £1 you donate to our Just Giving campaign between now and 18 December 11 AM UTC, you get 1 entry into the prize draw (so if you donate £10, you get 10 entries, and so forth). At the end of the stream we will pick winners together on screen, so make sure to donate and enter your email address (the optional field at donation, not as a comment) for a chance to win one of the following amazing prizes:
 


Noblechairs ICON in white
PlayStation 4 Pro
Xbox One X
Thrustmaster (for platform of your choice)
Elgato StreamDeck Mini
HyperX headsets
Corsair HS50, GLAIVE Mouse, MM800 pad
Frontier Goodiebag
Frontier Game Bundle on the platform of your choice x3 (contains Elite Dangerous + Horizons, Planet Coaster Deluxe, Jurassic World Evolution, and LostWinds 1 + 2)
Planet Coaster Vinyl
Frontier £25 Merch Design Voucher x3
... and much more!



Milestones!
 
You are changing lives by donating to SpecialEffect and for that we cannot thank you enough! During the 24 hour livestream, for every £1,000 we reach in donations, we have a milestone activation - this will unlock a special giveaway or some secret Frontier content for you! So do keep supporting the cause during the stream as much as you can, and help us reach our target goal of £30,000!
 
Streaming Schedule
 
We've also enlisted the help of some fabulous community content creators to help us raise as much money as possible. During the 24 hours, we have a separate streaming schedule where you can always find someone playing the game or doing charity challenges with their communities. We will post the full roster as soon as possible.
 
Thank you as always for the incredible and valuable support during the past year; from the launch of Jurassic World Evolution to the community meet-ups and the countless game updates, it means the world to us to have you by our side. We hope you're excited to join our cause and our celebration, and remember that it's all going towards SpecialEffect. Every little bit makes a huge difference in someone else's life.
 
See you on 17 December, 12PM UTC!
 
https://twitch.tv/frontierdevelopments
 
https://www.justgiving.com/fundraising/Frontier-Developments
 
 
Terms and Conditions
 
Charity Sweepstake 


Every full £1 (UK British pounds) donated to the Just Giving page is an entry into the prize draw.
If a donation is made in another currency, it will be converted to make sure you receive the correct number of entries into the prize draw.
The prize draw will be held on 18 December, 2018 at 11AM UTC as the final part of the livestream. Any donation made between the time this post goes live and 18 December, 2018 11AM UTC will count towards this prize draw.
For prize draw tickets to be valid, they must include suitable contact details. Please put your email address in the donation field (not as a publicly viewable comment).
Prizes in the Sweepstake may be substituted for one of equal value if, for any reason, they become unavailable, such as going out of stock.
Prizes are available worldwide.
Where a prize is not deliverable by a specific merchant, vouchers may be offered for a suitable retailer instead. Specifically for the Gaming PC, Xbox One X and PlayStation 4 Pro.
Prizes will be shipped in January 2019, after all the winners' addresses have been collected. Game codes will be sent as soon as possible after the stream concludes on 18 December.

notes.title: LostWinds 2 Update
notes.content:
Greetings everyone,

Just a swift note on a new update to LostWinds we released today:

Scenery objects (foliage, particle effects, etc) now respond to Enril (i.e. the cursor) passing over them, which makes the world feel that bit more responsive and alive.
We reduced the amount of slow motion, especially when using the gust power on environment objects. This makes the game flow nicer; previously, any gust would cause significant slow motion for a few seconds.

Thanks for continuing to support Frontier games!

Enjoy!
